title: Circuit Tracing in Vision-Language Models: Localizing Where Images Override Text Safety

original_idea.body:
# Circuit Tracing in Vision-Language Models: Localizing Where Images Override Text Safety

**Problem:** Circuit Tracing in Vision-Language Models (arXiv:2602.20330, Feb 2026) builds attribution graphs incorporating image-embedding residuals, but does not study the safety case where an image jailbreaks a model whose text guardrails would otherwise refuse.

**Direction:** On a small open VLM, construct paired cases where a harmful request is refused as text but complied with when paired with an innocuous image, then use attribution-graph / activation-patching to locate where the image-derived signal bypasses the text refusal pathway. Report the layer/component where the override happens.

**Why it matters:** Multimodal jailbreaks are a growing attack surface that text-only safety work misses; mechanistically localizing the bypass is a self-contained study feasible on small open VLMs.

**Relevant context:** Circuit Tracing in Vision-Language Models: Understanding the Internal Mechanisms of Multimodal Thinking (arXiv:2602.20330, Feb 2026): attribution graphs incorporating image-embedding residuals reveal causal relations in multimodal computation.
